Fault in the question, not the script. The key "quick" and the option "hurried" are both on the house no-urgency ban, so the script cannot name its own answer: "The option left means fast, so it matches." That fails Move 3 (name the key and show it works), and no rewrite can fix it while the option set stays as it is. The item needs a key and option set that do not use banned words.
